dedupe_keys.name: liechtenstein free geodata downloads natural hazard maps official cadastral survey by municipality bus stops and lines traffic installations and accident prevention layers

description: The geodata portal of the Liechtenstein national administration offers a download area of free geodata sets from several offices. Contents: about 30 datasets, including natural hazard mapping from the Office of Civil Protection (141.6 MB), the official cadastral survey (amtliche Vermessung) for each municipality with parcels, buildings and land cover, bus stops and lines of the public transport operator Liemobil, cycle routes, traffic installations and control cables, major accident prevention (Störfallvorsorge) zones, road and rail noise by day and night, rivers with catchments, water protection zones, protective forest, population and workplace density, and a 1:10,000 topographic map; LiDAR point clouds from 2018 and 2024 are viewable online. Producer: the offices named with each dataset, coordinated by the Office of Civil Engineering and Geoinformation. Coverage: the whole of Liechtenstein. Format and access: file geodatabase and GeoPackage downloads (DXF for the cadastral survey) after accepting the terms, with metadata in the Swiss geocat.ch catalogue; other data are sold through a protected geoshop. Free; the terms allow commercial use and modification with attribution and share-alike redistribution. Caveats: a small country, so datasets are compact; utility networks other than traffic control cables are not in the free set. Simulation uses: hazard exposure of buildings and roads to floods, debris flows and landslides in an Alpine valley, bus network modelling, and cross-border studies with Swiss and Austrian data. Related records: the Swiss dams under federal supervision (data-switzerland-dams-under-federal-supervision) cover the neighbouring Rhine valley.
